'''Reflective armor''' or '''reflective plate armor'''<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that could withstand heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.

The [[Stiletto security droid]] was covered in reflective plate armor.<ref name="CFTD" />
